description.value: Liquor Giant is a family-owned liquor retail chain that has been serving the Fraser Valley since 2011, operating multiple stores across Chilliwack and Abbotsford under the Liquor Giant Group banner. The Chilliwack location was named Best Beer and Wine Store in Chilliwack by the 2026 Chilliwack Progress A-List readers' choice awards. Touring cyclists can stock up on BC craft beers, local wines, spirits, and ready-to-drink beverages, with bulk and event ordering also available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Liquor Giant Group is a real, operating family-owned liquor retail chain with a Chilliwack location, and the phone number 604-744-1550 matches the OSM tag exactly. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill) are mentioned anywhere on the website. The pre-enrichment metadata explicitly flags this OSM record as a potential duplicate of record 3f6fb7135d at the same address, and the website's footer head-office address (41582 Yale Road) differs from the OSM store address (32131 Marshall Road), leaving the specific store address unconfirmed.
